title: Sedmica 1 — ponavljanje
reviewerNotes: Week 1 review draft — recycle Lessons 1–6; ready for human review before publish.
storyBeat: Ana flips through a phone photo diary of Week 1 — Sebilj, kahva, Mrvica, the map, and the clock — and retells the week in short Bosnian lines.

vocabulary: Recycle Week 1: greetings, biti, numbers/café, family, places, time
Light diary words: sedmica, foto, priča
grammar: Remember: Gdje je…? and Koliko je sati?
culture: A first-week photo diary as a memory tool

grammar.title: Remember — biti and possessives
grammar.explanation: Week 1 core: Ja sam Ana. Ti si Emir. On je / Ona je… Pair with possessives: Moj prijatelj. Moja prijateljica. Moja mačka. If a noun ends in -a, try moja first.

examples.bosnian: Ja sam Ana. Ti si Emir.
examples.english: I am Ana. You are Emir.

grammar.title: Remember — where and when
grammar.explanation: Place kit: Gdje je…? Ovdje. Tamo. U Sarajevu. Kod Amire. Time kit: Koliko je sati? Danas / sutra + weekday. Put them in one diary line: Danas sam kod Amire. Sutra — mapa!

examples.bosnian: Koliko je sati? — Deset je sati.
examples.english: What time is it? — It is ten.

culture.title: A phone full of Week 1
culture.body: Ana scrolls six photos: the Sebilj fountain, a copper tray of kahva, Mrvica on a chair, a folded map with Mostar circled, the Sahat-kula against evening sky, and Amira’s smiling doorway. A photo diary is how travelers lock language to place. Say one Bosnian line per picture — that is today’s whole method. Week 1 ends at the same table where it found a home.

lessonBlocks.title: Lesson A — Recycle the toolkit
lessonBlocks.body: Rapid fire without notes: Zdravo! Ja sam… Drago mi je. Kahvu, molim. Koliko? Moj brat / Moja sestra. Gdje je mapa? Ovdje / tamo. Koliko je sati? Danas / sutra. Emir times Ana for two minutes. Misses are fine — laugh, repeat, move on. Circle three weak words and write them once with accents.
tips: Speed over perfection — then one careful rewrite
Revisit čćšžđ from Lesson 1 if typing slips

lessonBlocks.title: Lesson B — Photo diary captions
lessonBlocks.body: Write or say six captions, one per Week 1 beat: (1) Zdravo, Sarajevo! (2) Ja sam Ana. (3) Kahva kod Amire. (4) Moja mačka Mrvica. (5) Gdje je Mostar? Tamo. (6) Danas je petak — deset je sati. That sequence is your priča for Sedmica 1. Share it at the table; Amira stamps the week with Hvala — i sutra!
tips: Reuse chunks; do not invent new grammar today

funFacts.title: Six photos, six lines
funFacts.body: Captioning photos in the new language beats memorizing naked word lists. Your brain keeps the fountain with the greeting.

funFacts.title: Weak-word triage
funFacts.body: Week reviews are for hunting your personal fails — četvrtak, srijeda, moja/moj mix-ups — not for new rabbit holes.

funFacts.title: Sedmica means week
funFacts.body: Related to sedam (seven). Handy when Book 1 keeps counting weeks.

funFacts.title: Week 2 is food
funFacts.body: Next week opens with burek. Fuel up — and bring the Week 1 toolkit with you.
